title: Fixed-size window: add the one entering, drop the one leaving

steps.caption: Max sum of a window of size 3. Sum the first window once: 8.
Slide right: add 1, remove 2. Sum = 7 in O(1), no re-adding the whole window.
Slide right: add 3, remove 1. Sum = 9 in O(1), no re-adding the whole window.
Slide right: add 2, remove 5. Sum = 6 in O(1), no re-adding the whole window.
